messages:
alex: Hey team — quick eyes on https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1427? It's a small shim to keep the REST client headers backward-compatible with some proxies we've seen in the wild. Targeting today's 16:00 UTC merge window if approvals look good.

mira: On it. Quick question — does this touch streaming/toolcall header paths or only REST sync clients?

alex: Only REST client. Streaming path uses the new header shape and is untouched. I added unit tests + an integration fixture that mocks the legacy header. Snippet:```ts
// headers_shim.ts
if (!headers['x-rw-client-id'] && headers['x-rw-legacy-id']) {
  headers['x-rw-client-id'] = headers['x-rw-legacy-id'];
}
```

sam: I'll run the local e2e against a proxy replica and post results in ~20m. If ci is green and no perf regressions, approve from infra side.

ci-bot: build/test status: 5 passed, 2 flaky e2e (one timeout). Re-run queued (author requested).

mira: Small nit: can we add a comment referencing the proxy bug (#PLAT-289) so it's obvious why shim exists? Otherwise LGTM.

alex: Good call — added link and a one-line comment, pushed. Also added a brief changelog entry under docs/compat.md.

jen: Scanned changes. Tests look reasonable. One documentation nit: in the changelog note that this is a temporary shim and will be removed after proxy rollout. Otherwise :+1:.

kai: Heads up — if we merge in today's window, please flag Dedicated customers? We may need a short rollout note for SRE.

alex: Will do. I'll open a tiny rollout note in #eng-sre once merged.

sam: Local proxy tests passed (no regressions). CI re-run succeeded, all checks green.

jen: Approving now.

mira: Approved from API side.

alex: Thanks all — merging in the 16:00 UTC window. I'll tag the merge commit and post a follow-up in #eng-ops with rollout note and changelog link. :rocket:
